origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Imezdaɣ n ddunit
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: Ayen i d-yețwaxelqen lqayen, yesɛan lḥal, yesɛan azal d waman, yezmer ad ițțusemmi d iɛsekṛiyen, țɛeṭṭil, yeffɣen ɣef lqaɛa.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Aman yesɛan lfeṛḥ am ṣṣifa n igenni, ițwali s ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Llamin s uẓekka di leɛmeṛ n lmeṣnuɛat.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Ldi Aman
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Sbeggnet-ed s lqaɛa si lexla n lebḥeṛ, mačči kan ɣer lebḥeṛ.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Ur nelli ara n wemdan
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: ?ṭef amkan n lqayen m'ara d-yeɣli mbla lqayen, m'ur d-issers ara. ?ef wannect-agi txeddmem lxiṛ.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Pessivivore
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Ur zmiren ara aț-țeččen kan iselman. Imeqqranen n wudmarin ur zmiren ara ad ibedd lmeṣnuɛat-agi (ocean_origines.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Ur nesɛi lḥal akk-d lḥal am leɛmeṛ i gɛeddan.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Tețṛuḥuṛ-ed seg waman s tezmert iǧehden, ifeṛṛeḥ akteṛ n wemkan n wemkan.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Allen-nsen țwalin ɣer ṭṭlam n ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țesɛu aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (ițțusemman K).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 ulawen (+4 taxaṭer HP). Di tdukli n ṣṣifa n leǧwahi yebnan ṭṭmeɛ ameqqran.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Llamin s uẓekka m'ara ffɣen deg-sen.
Mkul tlata sennig, mkul amkan n waman yesɛan azal n 1 HP.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij, tețțawi-d 1.5 cceṛ m'ara d-yaweḍ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Rrif dinna
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Mazal-ikkun tesɛam seg waman, aṭas n waman, aṭas n waman i d-tekkam. Ițwaɣeḍ, d aman, d aman, d aman, neɣ d aqṛuc n waman i gzedɣen, ṭṭfen-t kullec.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Iɛedda n ddnub
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: ?ef wannect-agi n taggara, a d-yaweḍ leḥsab n tlemmast, a d-tebɛen lebɛid, aṭas n ccehwat i gețwaḍeggṛen.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Aț-tețwakkes anda tețmuquleḍ ( alamma d 24 sblacks) ; tnefsit-ed snat tazmert.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam s wayes ara yili di ṭṭlam.
Ur teẓriḍ ara zdat-ek m'ur ten-tḥesbeḍ ara.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Mkul sennig, m'ara d-yaweḍ aman neɣ m'ara d-yawi waman, m'ara d-yefk ayen ur nesɛi ara, a d-yețțaggad aman.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Ur nezmir ara ad yeɛǧi lmeɛna
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: ssadaț n idɣaɣen
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: D imezdaɣ yeddren i d-ixelqen, d imezdaɣ ur nezmir ara ad yezmir ɣef isennanen, d azṛu s ifassen n leḥṛam, dɣa yețțak-ed tiftilin n ddnub ɣer ṭṭlam. Ur d-yețțak ara lqaɛa ur ten-yeǧǧi ara.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 ulawen (+6 max HP). Lǧețța n wedɣaɣ yesɛan akteṛ n lǧețța n wemdan.
20% deg-sen i d-yețțaken cceṛ i wid iḥekkmen.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: Tețzuxxu 10% yesɛan azal akteṛ n wemdan.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Megren tikkelt tikkelt snat am uẓummen.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Imeqqranen ur sɛin ara di 48 sblac.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Imeqqranen
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: D leḥṛam i d-yețțaken ddunit yezgaren, d lehna akk-d leḥṛam, lameɛna d ayen i d-yețwagezmen seg wemdan n Nejṛa.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Imdanen meṛṛa, d wid iɛewdiwen, ur kkun-iḥader ara m'ur tɣellim ara.
Yal izuṛan yeɣli-d, ur d-yeɣli ara cceṛ.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Axaṭer issefhem di leḥṛam di leḥṛam.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: ?ef wannect n senniḍen, sɛan tnac n lexṣaṣ di tektabt n Netter.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Yiwen aqcic n ṭṭlam, yezger tazmert n tezmert ṭṭlam, yesseɣli-d ger imukan iwakken a d-yekkes ifassen ; tɛeǧbeḍ deg ṭṭlam, yețɛeggiḍ si ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Imuqel di ṭṭlam s wayes ara yili di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfeǧǧiǧ deg aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (iwumi yella K).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Tili
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Tesɛiḍ taẓawaḍ deg ufus i deg tețṛuḥuḍ. Tesɛiḍ snat tazmert.
M'ara d-yaweḍ yiwet n lexsaṛa m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: ?ef ṭṭlam-inek, tɛeggiḍ-ed aẓekkun ur nesɛi lmeɛna.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Tili
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Dɛut aɛekkaz ur nesɛi lǧehd i gzemren 28-nni ɣer ṭṭlam. Armi ț-țamdint n ṛebɛa yesɛan lfayda, iserreḥ-ed yiwen ajdid iwakken a d-yessufuɣ tazmert imezwura ; tnefsit-ed snat tazmert.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: ?-țideț i k-id-yefka tazmert di teswiɛt i tețmuquleḍ ; tnefsit-ed snat tazmert, ṛebɛa-nni tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Aṭas n leṛwaḥ
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Ɣuṛ-wat aț-țesɛuḍ deg igenni s ifṛax iǧehden iǧehden.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen ṛebɛa snat n tmes i d-tețmuquleḍ, tlata tazmert i tesɛiḍ, ṛebɛa tis snat i d-tefkiḍ.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Lebaṛaka n lǧețța n ddunit
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: ?-țideț, tețfeǧǧiǧ deg ubrid-ik, am akken i d-ițțunefkent lbaṛakat n ddunit.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Timliḥt
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Izuṛan meṛṛa i gzedɣen lǧețțat iǧehden, s tezmert n ṛebɛa senniḍen. Lǧețțat n tnefsit tnefsit, sseɣlin-d 200.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Lfayda n leswaṛ yesɛan lǧehd deg ufus i tețmuquleḍ. 3-es sennig n tmes.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Tmes tazmert n ṭṭmeɛt i gzemren ɣer tmura n ṭṭmeɛt ; tnefsit tazmert nniḍen, ṛebɛa-nni tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Axaṭer m'ara textaṛeḍ ayagi, yesɛan tazmert tameqqrant iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ tazmert tameqqrant iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ tazmert tameqqrant.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Lxuluq n lebḥeṛ iɛeǧben, iselman d iḥeṛṛiyen, rewlen fell-ak awal.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Lfayda n leswaṛ iǧehden deg ufus i tețmuquleḍ, tlata tazmert i tesɛiḍ.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Imukan aẓekka n azṛu i d-tețmuquleḍ ɣer uẓekka. 100-nni tfeǧǧiḍ.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: m'ara d-texleq lbeṛhanat neɣ tegzirt, tețțawi-d yiwet n tnefsit n tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: Ur yezmir ara a d-asen laẓ !

jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Yesseɣli-d wid yextaṛen kullec, iwakken ad ițwaxelqen wid yextaṛ lxiṛ. Lfayda 5 XP m'ara nesɛeddi s uqbel (ixeddem uqbel lḥeqq).

emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Issersen-ed kan anezṛan n tegzirt-ik, iwakken aț-țeldiḍ i wid yextaṛ aɣes iwakken aț-țeṭṭfeḍ tazmert-ik tameqqrant. Idrimen 2 XP m'ara tesɛi lfayda.

origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Yiwet n imdanen yesɛan leḥṛam, yesɛan leḥṛam, yesɛan leḥṛam, lameɛna lǧețța-s ur nesɛi ara lǧețța.

Yezmer ad ṭṭfeɛ ɣef yiman-is, ad ṭṭfeɛ ɣef yiman-is.

power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Ilaq-ed ad ițțuẓummen acḥal yesɛan lxuf.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Ɣeffliq
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Yiwet n lxelq ifeṛḥen di ṭṭlam akk-d iger n ṭṭmeɛ, yesseɣli-d s lḥuc yesɛan azal, meɛna yekref-ed yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Tmes iɛeǧǧayen iɛeǧben i d-ițțaken ɣer tagut i d-ițțaken lḥebs ; tlata lḥaǧa ; 12-es seǧǧa ;
